en: Black-and-white postcard showing a multi‑storey institutional building with a tiled mansard roof and large windows. A wrought‑iron fence with brick pillars surrounds the property, and several people in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk along a cobblestone street in front. On the façade appears the sign 'INSTITUTUL DE IGIENĂ'. A printed caption at the bottom reads 'CLUJ – Institutul de igienă Pasteur'.
